title: Countries with Red and White Flags

sources.name: Flags and Anthems of the World - Britannica
List of Flags by Color Combination - Wiki

_: Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom). Similar to Monaco, but wider (2:3 ratio).
White field with a red circle in the center.
Red field with a white crescent moon and single white five-pointed star positioned left/hoist-of-center.
A white field with a red maple leaf in the center and thick red vertical bars along both sides.
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom). Similar to Indonesia and Monaco, but colors are reversed, and to Greenland, but without the circle.
Three equal vertical stripes of (from left/hoist) red, white, and red.
Red field with a centered a white circle, in which lies a red crescent moon and single red five-pointed star.
Three equal horizontal stripes of (from top) red, white, and red.
Square red flag with a centered white Swiss/Greek cross (all arms equal length).
Red field with a stylised white five-petal Hong Kong orchid tree blossom in the center.
A red field overlaid with a white Nordic cross (vertical stripe set slightly left/hoist of center).
Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom) with white crescent moon and five five-pointed stars in upper left/hoist corner.
White field split into quadrants by a red cross, with a smaller red Georgian cross in each quadrant.
A maroon field with a jagged-edged white vertical stripe along the left/hoist edge. Similar to Bahrain but with a darker red and an unusually narrow 28:11 aspect ratio.
Three horizontal stripes of (from top) double-thick red, white, and double-thick red.
A red field with a jagged-edged white vertical stripe along the left/hoist edge. Similar to Qatar but with a brighter red and a more traditional 5:3 aspect ratio.

Half-width bars of white (left/hoist) and red (right/fly) field with a red-lined white cross in the upper left/hoist corner. Inside the cross is a drawing of Saint George ringed by the words "For Gallantry".
Red field with a white square in the upper left/hoist corner, in which is centered a red Greek cross.
Two thick horizontal stripes of white (top), and red (bottom) with a left-of-center circle of the opposite color (ie, red on top and white on the bottom).
Double-thick white horizontal band atop a band of red, with a red castle in the center and a gold key hanging from the castle's entryway.
Two thick horizontal stripes of red (top), and white (bottom). Similar to Indonesia, but nearly square (4:5 ratio).
